note: Both sets correctly capture the four Table 6-2 values (87.6 m height, 347,460 kg mass, 38.234 m CM location, 1% damping) with supporting quotes. Set A preserves the important damping condition from the prose (isolated tower, without rotor-nacelle assembly mass, all modes), which Set B drops, keeping only 'all modes'. Both sets restate the height and CM facts under two names, and Set A additionally repeats the mass and CM claims, so both suffer from duplication, but A's extra claims are faithful restatements rather than errors.
remarks: Both sets state the height (87.6 m) and CM location (38.234 m) twice under slightly different attribute names; Set A also repeats the mass. The 'undistributed' qualifier used by Set A comes from the table title 'Undistributed Tower Properties' and is a table-level scope note rather than a per-row condition. Neither set captures the DOWEC/Ref. [14] provenance of the damping value, which is arguably a minor omission for both.
